text:
Mara (marketing): Quick design ask — need a set of launch assets for the microbenchmark push and webinar funnel. Deliverables: 6-card social carousel, landing hero (webinar signup), and 3 lead-capture tile variants for inbound flows. Brand-safe and legal sweep required. Deadline: Thu EOD (4 days). Priority: high.

Joey (design): Got it. Can you confirm dimensions, exact copy variants, and whether we need motion/GIFs or static only?

Mara (marketing): Sizes: social carousel cards 1080x1080, single-feed hero 1200x628, landing hero 1440x600, tiles 600x600. Need 2x motion/GIF variants for social (2s loop). Copy snippets (pick one per asset):
- Headline A: "Serving wins: lower cost, consistent latency"
- Headline B: "Predictable inference. Smarter unit economics."
- Subline: "Join our webinar — live demo + benchmark deep dive"
CTA: "Save my seat" / "See the numbers"
Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/microbench-launch (placeholders ok).

Sam (product): Add a tiny sparkline / mini chart showing tokens/sec across runs on the carousel. Keep it schematic — values are illustrative. Also include small footnote: "internal tests; results vary by workload".

Leo (growth): For experimentation we need 3 creative variants mapped to routing:
- Variant COST -> /demo?utm=cost
- Variant LATENCY -> /demo?utm=latency
- Variant FRIENDLY -> /demo?utm=explainer
Also request an email/social GIF (2s) showing the sparkline animating. Tracking: ensure each tile has distinct hidden field `utm_campaign=microbench_launch_v1`.

Joey (design): Cool. Can someone paste the small sample numbers for the sparkline so I don't mock nonsense? Also confirm legal wording constraints.

Mara (marketing): Sample numbers (very small):
```
tokens_per_sec: [1500, 1400, 1600, 1550, 1480]
cost_per_token_usd: [0.0008, 0.0006, 0.0009, 0.0007, 0.00065]
```
Legal note: avoid absolute superlatives like "cheapest" or naming competitor models. Add "based on internal benchmarks" footnote and link to methodology doc in the landing. CC @Elena for final sweep.

Dana (creative): Accessibility checks: use brand palette but ensure AA contrast on all cards. Suggest bg swap for tile variant B -> #0f1720 with white text. Buttons should be 16px, 600 weight, rounded 6px. For GIFs keep color changes subtle (no strobing).

Elena (legal): Quick guidance: confirm that any numeric claims are attributed ("internal tests on sample workloads"). No comparative statements referencing other vendors. If you use percentages, include sample size note. I can sign off with final art export — please @ me in the file when mocks are ready.

BrandOps Bot: Reminder — include brand hex list and primary/secondary font weights in the figma file. Brand guideline: https://redwood.com/brand (internal). Also run contrast check before final export.

Joey (design): Timeline: I’ll drop first static mocks by tomorrow 10:00am PT (three variants + one landing hero). GIFs mock + two motion passes by Wed afternoon. I will add the sparkline using the sample numbers and include an artboard named `LEGAL_REVIEW`.

Mara (marketing): Perfect — after Joey uploads, I’ll route to growth + legal for quick checks and then ops for routing tags. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Leo (growth): One more ask — can we get alternate CTA copy for a lower-friction path: "Get results" (no signup) vs. "Save my seat" (webinar)? We’ll A/B test.

Joey (design): Will include both CTAs as locked text layers for easy swap.

Mara (marketing): Great — I’ll post tracker and review checklist in the thread once mocks land.

Elena (legal): Please remember to add the methodology link text exactly: "Methodology: internal benchmark on sample workloads — details at redwood.com/benchmarks" before sending to customers.

Joey (design): Noted. Uploading artboards shortly.

Mara (marketing): Thanks team — expecting mocks tomorrow.
